goal: Test whether strictly-past number rankings can be conformalized into naturally small 6-of-49 prediction pools that retain reproducible 5-of-6 coverage without target tuning.

nearestPriorFamilies.difference: v294 searches recurrent set states; v317 calibrates a coverage threshold from strictly prior rank residuals.
v316 uses transport geometry; v317 uses finite-sample conformal rank coverage and a hard playable-set-size gate.

regime.reason: Keep one shared 6-of-49 regime; no cross-regime mapping inside v317.

method.targetEvent: At least 5 of the 6 winning main numbers are contained in a pre-draw conformal pool.
method.nonconformityScore: For each historical draw, rank all 49 numbers using a base ranking computed only from earlier draws; the score is the rank position of the fifth-best-ranked winning number. Smaller is better.
method.calibration: For each target draw, use only previous nonconformity scores from the frozen rolling calibration window. Let m be the number of calibration scores and j=min(m,ceil((m+1)*(1-alpha))); Kraw is the j-th smallest calibration score.
method.playability: The conformal pool is the top K ranked numbers where K=max(6,Kraw). The draw is playable for this experiment only when K<=8. No truncation from K>8 to 8 is allowed.
method.budget: For K=6..8 evaluate all C(K,6) lines. At K=8 this is 28 lines and 14 EUR under the project Bonoloto-equivalent 0.50 EUR line convention; real stake remains zero.

rankingDefinitions.hot: Within the strictly prior trailing W draws, rank 1..49 by descending appearance count; tie-break lower number first.
rankingDefinitions.overdue: Using strictly prior history and capped search within trailing W draws, rank by descending draws-since-last-appearance; never-seen-inside-window is assigned gap W+1; tie-break lower number first.
rankingDefinitions.recent: Same frozen gap statistic as overdue, but rank ascending gap; tie-break lower number first.
rankingDefinitions.hot_gap_hybrid: For each number compute frequencyShare=count/(6W) and gapShare=min(gap,W+1)/(W+1); score=0.65*frequencyShare+0.35*gapShare; rank descending score, tie-break lower number first. Coefficients are frozen before Stage1-2.

stage1_2SelectionRules.behaviorHash: SHA-256 of chronological emitted playable target date, K and pool for the development evaluation window.
stage1_2SelectionRules.failurePolicy: If no configuration meets all predeclared gates in development, close v317 without opening blind OOS.

matchedNull.type: Exact hypergeometric matched to each emitted pool size K
